title: Optimum
description: A modpack which aims to optimise Minecraft as much as possible, and still keep the vanilla experience, while providing QoL features you'll constantly use!
body:
# Vanilla, enhanced.

_Fed up of playing Minecraft with constant stutters and complicated UI?_

Look no further than **Vanilla+**, the ultimate modpack which brings both optimisation and QoL to Minecraft, doubling your frames AND improving the general experience with features such as revamped containers UI, shulker box tooltips and MORE!

Compatible with Feather Client! (not included)

<details>
<summary>Benchmarks</summary>

  - 1440p Fast graphics (unoptimised) ~300 FPS
  
- 1440p Fast graphics (Vanilla+) ~500 FPS

- 1440p Minimum settings (Vanilla+, superflat world looking at sky) - 1200 FPS

Tested on a Ryzen 9 5900x, RTX 3080 and 32GB of DDR4 RAM.
</details>


All featured/mentioned mods are NOT owned by me, they belong to their respective creators, and the mods are uploaded to Modrinth on the basis that they may be used in modpacks.
